generic.suggestedMessagesHint: Quick-reply chips visitors can tap to start a conversation.

apiSetup.prerequisitesDescription: External API calls require a public, active agent with API deployment enabled. You can test from the Try panel before publishing.
apiSetup.apiKeyDescription: Use this key in the Authorization header. Keep it secret — rotate if exposed.
apiSetup.regenerateDescription: The current key will stop working immediately. Update any integrations using the old key.
